summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper. Changes: botocore/regions.py adds the EndpointResolverBuiltins str-Enum with the eleven members from the spec (plus a stdlib `from enum import Enum` import). botocore/args.py adds the EPRBuiltins import and the public compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults method on ClientArgsCreator after _ensure_boolean; the STS global-endpoint predicate now accepts endpoint_config=None. tests/unit/test_args.py adds TestEndpointResolverBuiltins (derives from unittest.TestCase) with tests for each behavioral criterion. Verification: tests/unit/test_args.py 59 passed; test_regions, test_client, test_endpoints, test_sts, test_utils: 1346 passed in total. Not verified: black was not available in the shared venv, so formatting was checked by hand; botocore/args.py:315 is 82 columns but predates this change. Nothing was committed.
